t: 探索者罗伯特·卡维利埃·德·拉·萨勒(英语:Robert Cavellier de La Sa…
te: Explorer Robert Cavelier de La Salle, searching for the mouth of the Mississippi River, is murdered by his own men.
dz: 探索者罗伯特·卡维利埃·德·拉·萨勒(英语:Robert Cavellier de La Salle),寻找密西西比河口,被自己人所谋杀.
de: Explorer Robert Cavelier de La Salle, searching for the mouth of the Mississippi River, is murdered by his own men.

t: 洛林的查尔斯击败了奥斯曼帝国.
te: Charles of Lorraine defeats the Ottoman Empire.
dz: 摩哈克之战:洛林的查尔斯击败了奥斯曼帝国.
de: Battle of Mohács: Charles of Lorraine defeats the Ottoman Empire.

t: 雅典的帕台农会被奥斯曼守军用作火药库,被威尼斯部队在围攻阿克罗波利斯时被轰炸后被部分摧毁.

dz: 莫兰战争:雅典的帕台农会被奥斯曼守军用作火药库,被威尼斯部队在围攻阿克罗波利斯时被轰炸后被部分摧毁.
de: Morean War: The Parthenon in Athens, used as a gunpowder depot by the Ottoman garrison, is partially destroyed after being bombarded during the Siege of the Acropolis by Venetian forces.

t: 吉罗拉莫角城下的威尼斯人从奥斯曼帝国取出赫尔塞克诺维城.
te: The Venetians under Girolamo Corner take the city of Herceg Novi from the Ottoman Empire.
dz: 吉罗拉莫角城下的威尼斯人从奥斯曼帝国取出赫尔塞克诺维城.

t: 第一艘胡格诺茨从法国起航去往好望角.
te: The first Huguenots set sail from France to the Cape of Good Hope.
dz: 第一艘胡格诺茨从法国起航去往好望角.
